Defines asset connection entry point. The base pattern for HTTP is defined in Qalifier.
Defines content type based on a media type (e.g., text/plain) and potential character decoding/encoding type (e.g., charset=utf-8) for the media type (see RFC2046) of the whole interface.
Selects one or more of the security scheme(s) that can be applied at runtime from the collection of security schemes defines in securityDefinitions.
ReferenceElement within the SML points to a sercurity scheme definition in the SMC securityDefinitions.
Defines the security scheme according to W3C.
This SubmodelElements holds the information about security mechanism based on nosec security.
Defines the security mechanism that used during access. the scheme for nosec_sc is nosec
This SubmodelElements holds the information about security mechanism based on auto security.
Defines the security mechanism that used during access. The scheme for auto_sc is auto.
This SubmodelElements holds the information about security mechanism based on opcua_channel security.
Defines the security mechanism that used during access. The scheme for opcua_channel_sc is ua_channelsec.
Provides information about the security modes supported by the OPC UA server endpoint(e.g None, Sign,SignAndEncrypt)
Provides information about which policy options are available from the supported endpoints of the OPC UA server(e.g None, Basic256Sha256)
This SubmodelElements holds the information about security mechanism based on opcua_authentication security.
Defines the security mechanism that used during access. The scheme for opcua_authentication_sc is ua_authentication.
Provides information about which policy options are available from the supported endpoints of the OPC UA server (e.g Anonymous)
